Evaluation benchmark for Korean government document parsing, used to evaluate WigtnOCR-2B.

Page images (PNG) + Pseudo-GT (Markdown)


GT Source
Qwen3-VL-30B (generation) + Qwen3.5-122B (validation, score ≥ 3/5)

val.jsonl              # 294 samples, each with image path + GT markdown
images/… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Wigtn/KoGovDoc-Bench.
reputation: A niche Korean government document parsing benchmark used primarily in evaluations of OCR and document-structure extraction models; limited but increasing use.
